row.constraints: Nonempty finite float32 or float64 matrix (N,D). Input precision is preserved and storage copied. Caller controls feature scaling and the Euclidean metric; no domain identifiers or partitioning policy.

row.name: random_state
row.constraints: Integer seed in [0, 2**32-1]; booleans rejected. No cross-version reproducibility guarantee.

row.constraints: Finite copied center matrix (K,D), preserving input float precision and backend cluster order. Single native thread; no global optimum guarantee.

row.name: labels
